title: Package Impact Score
brief: Our open-source dashboard ranks maintainers by an impact score. For each maintainer we know how many other projects depend on each of their packages.

The score is the largest number h such that the maintainer has at least h packages that each have at least h dependents. Implement impactScore(dependents), where dependents[i] is the dependent count of package i, and return that score.
